title: Frontier Airlines Signs Two of College Football’s Biggest Backsides to a First Class NIL Deal
summary: DENVER – Nov. 19, 2026 – Quarterbacks land endorsements for their arms. Receivers land them for their hands. Offensive linemen? Their moment has finally arrived - and they can enjoy it sitting down.Frontier Airlines today announced a name, image and likeness (NIL) partnership with University of Georgia offensive linemen Juan Gaston and Jahza...
body_markdown:
“Our new First Class seats offer more of what travelers want: more room, more comfort and great value,” said Bobby Schroeter, Chief Marketing Officer, Frontier Airlines. “Juan and Jahzare spend every game making room for other people. We thought it was time someone returned the favor.”


The linemen offered their own endorsements.


“When Frontier called, I didn’t expect my seat to be part of the deal,” said Gaston. “But at 6-foot-7 and 360 pounds, I take having enough room pretty seriously. This is a partnership I can get comfortable with.”


“I’ve signed a lot of things, but this was a first,” said Jackson. “More room, no middle seat and a contract you sign sitting down? I’m in.”


**More Room. More Comfort. Great Value.**


Frontier’s new First Class seats feature two-by-two seating in the first two rows, with no middle seats and up to 37 inches of seat pitch. The First bundle includes a First Class seat, two checked bags, a carry-on and Board First priority boarding.


First Class seats are available for travel beginning March 5, 2027, alongside expanded extra-legroom Premium seating in rows 3–8. Additional enhancements rolling out through 2027 include USB-C power in the first eight rows and Starlink Wi-Fi.


Linemen spend all season making room for everyone else. Frontier’s new First Class makes room for them - and for travelers who want more space at a low fare.


**Ready to Take Your Seat?**


Frontier’s new First bundle is on sale now from just $129* one way for travel beginning March 5, 2027. Book the First bundle at FlyFrontier.com or through the Frontier mobile app.
